title: nan
key_contribution: Proposes an IF-MADDPG deep reinforcement learning algorithm integrating INS, GNSS, and visual navigation for multi-UAV integrated navigation in GNSS-denied environments, validated in simulations and experiments.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Optimization_Based_VIO to ensure precise positioning.
